detail.longDescription:
Wow

As an example of how #Mastodon often works at the #Github level, here a #Post subject and the #Reply that closed the Github #Issue

"Re: [mastodon/mastodon] Bad decision: renaming "Bookmarks" to "Saved Posts" (Issue # 40357)"

"Hi! as stated in the linked PR, these new designs are not open to feedback yet. when we are in a place to beta test things, we'll have a place to submit feedback but for now i'm closing this as things are still very much in flux."

Read: "We're not gonna change this right now but when we are, maybe we'll listen then"

Except that when it's farther along the Mastodon devs won't want to change anything

Yup...

...seen it a million times
